Keys such as `__proto__` and `constructor` are ordinary data keys, including when supplied by `JSON.parse`. Each property value is either a primitive (`string`, `number`, `boolean`, or `null`) or a one-level nested plain object whose values are primitives. Merge top-level keys, with overrides winning. When both sides of a key are nested objects, merge their own immediate fields, preserving default fields not present in the override. Otherwise replace the value with the override, including `false`, `0`, and `null`. Return a fresh top-level object and fresh nested objects; never mutate or retain nested object references from either argument. Calls must be independent, including repeated calls with the same defaults.
